Battle of Mahaban in 1018 AD was the military conflict which was launched by Mahmud against the kulchand of mahaban..
Battle
Mahmud turned his attention towards the Mahaban fort of kulchand which was located in the Mathura, district of Uttar Pradesh.
Mahmud arrived in 1018 AD with his soldiers to fight kulchand. The news reached  to Kulchand then he collected superior troops and elephants and waited for mahmud so that he can attack mahmud. When the both forces arrived face to face Mahmud inflicted crushing defeat on kulchand and forced him to flee. Kulchand and his forces threw themselves in the river to escape but many were put to swords and some taken prisoners.
Kulchand finding he can't escape sultan's wrath then he drew up his dagger, killed his wife and then slew himself. In this bloody  thirsty battle , atleast 50,000 hindus lost their life. Rich spoil and 185 elephants captured by the forces of Mahmud
